messages:
maria: FYI — Large strategic customer asked for a bespoke SKU: reserved tier + per-tenant burst credits + priority routing for certain job types. They want this in contract negotiation next week. Thoughts on launch gating?
aj: Do we have a precedent for SKU-level priority routing? I remember a pilot with Partner A but not widely available.
zoe: we did a partner pilot but it was fragile cost-wise. We had to cap burst at 200k tokens/month to stay profitable.
tomas: engineering concerns: priority routing impacts latency SLOs unless we reserve capacity. That means dedicated GPU pool or explicit QoS tokens.
lee: finance — need a hard floor on revenue to justify reserved capacity. If burst gets abused we lose margin. Can we do a softcap + overage pricing?
maria: proposal from sales: softcap at 150k, burst multiplier 1.6x overage, and an add-on for priority routing (monthly fee). Customer expects priority routing included but willing to pay more.
aj: sales wants it in a 12-month contract with trial month. Can we offer canary rollout?
tomas: technical rollout plan suggestion: phase 1 = manual routing tags + rate limiter; phase 2 = autoscaling + reserved pool. Phase 1 doable in 2 sprints.
zoe: ops risk: if we don't isolate, noisy tenants can affect others. What's the fallback policy? automatic degrade to best-effort?
maria: fallback idea: priority-routing flag -> routes to dedicated queue; if capacity exhausted, fall back to same-model but quantized variant (lower cost). Customers must opt-in to fallback in contract.
lee: contract constraint: must allow us to apply fallback without SLA breach if customer agreed. Also need minimum monthly commit to support reserved pool (suggest $30k/mo).
aj: this is sticky for negotiations. Customers might push back on minimums. Can we introduce a mid-tier with lower commit and slower performance?
tomas: mid-tier could be implemented with burst credits only (no hard reserved pool) + higher latency SLO. Lower infra cost but we should document expected p95.
zoe: propose guardrails: per-tenant burst window (30d), burst cap, and automated throttles. Also audit logs for routing decisions.
maria: ok concrete ask: product needs a launch checklist and clear tradeoff doc for sales by EOD Friday. Can someone draft tradeoffs and suggested contract language?
lee: I can draft contract bullets: commit levels, softcap, overage multiplier, fallback clause, audit & termination rights.
aj: I'll prep negotiation playbook and examples of concession ladders.
tomas: I'll sketch implementation phases + estimated capacity cost delta (rough numbers).
zoe: I'll write runbook for ops + alert thresholds.
product-bot: Reminder — product sync scheduled tomorrow 10:00. Attach draft to the doc before 9:30 to get on agenda. :bell:
maria: great, team. Quick callout — include sample config snippet for clarity, e.g.:
```
commit: 30000
tier: "reserved_plus"
burst: 150000 # tokens/month
burst_window_days: 30
overage_multiplier: 1.6
priority_routing: true
fallback_variant: "quantized-v2"
```
zoe: lgtm, add monitoring metrics (burst_usage, fallback_count, p95_latency) to snippet.
lee: can we add a pricing example table? sales needs 2-3 scenarios (low, mid, high).
maria: I'll collate all of that and push a consolidated doc. Thanks everyone. :pray:
